description: 경상북도 예천군_재난대응용 배수펌프장 시설현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경상북도 예천군. 본 자료는 집중호우, 태풍 등 자연재해 발생 시 침수 피해를 예방하기 위한 기반시설 관리에 활용되며, 재난안전대책 수립, 수방 능력 평가, 유지보수 계획 수립 등 다양한 행정적 목적에. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
